title: Freeze demo-only V2 and open machine_vision real-runtime SOP workstream
user_business_goal: Freeze the completed Flange QC V2 demo-only/no-camera workstream and open the next real-runtime SOP workstream under machine_vision so future agent work prioritizes camera, calibration, geometry, product specs, and full SOP rule gates before advanced model defect work.
out_of_scope: live camera SDK import or live capture
raw media storage or customer/factory data
model deserialization or inference runtime loading
dataset notebooks or raw dataset management
acceptance_criteria: Add a source-of-truth workstream manifest that marks demo-only V2 work as frozen and machine_vision real-runtime SOP as the active workstream.
Document that demo-only/replay/HMI polish is closed except for regression fixes, evidence corrections, security or policy repair, or owner-approved emergency unblock.
Document the active workstream priority order: camera hardware/readiness, calibration, runtime geometry, product specs approval package, full SOP rule gate, then advanced model defect work.
Make advanced model defect work explicitly blocked until the earlier gates are recorded.
Add tests that fail if the workstream manifest loses the freeze, active machine_vision workstream, priority order, or advanced-model deferral.
Existing product CI and full repository checks pass.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 pause state, demo-only freeze, machine_vision real-runtime SOP, camera calibration geometry product specs full rule gate before advanced model defects.
retrieved_decisions: V2 no-camera/replay baseline is complete enough to pause.
POST /inspection/intake is the real runtime handoff.
Production authority remains blocked until hardware, calibration, product specs, QC/SOP, model, release, staging, rollback, and monitoring gates pass.
retrieved_lessons: Do not create more demo-only polish work while waiting for real inputs.
Prioritize deterministic SOP readiness before model-dependent defect sophistication.
Keep model observations review-only until runtime SOP gates and model approval evidence exist.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: Current docs still described replay/no-camera MVP as the active baseline and did not name machine_vision as the active real-runtime workstream.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-054 PR to remove the workstream manifest, status doc, tests, and documentation updates. No runtime app behavior, data, secrets, hardware state, model artifacts, migrations, or release state is changed.
